title: 3I/ATLAS — interstellar comet, Aug vs Dec 2025
story: SPHEREx pointed at interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS twice: quiet in August 2025 (CO2 coma only) and erupting in December 2025 (H2O 40x up, organics, dust tail). Same sky, 4 months apart — drag the slider.

epochs.label: 2025-08-01 · pre-perihelion
epochs.note: CO2 coma ~3 arcmin, H2O/CO undetected. Lisse et al. RNAAS 9:242.

epochs.label: 2025-12-14 · post-perihelion
epochs.note: Fully active: H2O, CO, CN, organics C-H, dust tail. Lisse et al. RNAAS 2026.

citation.text: This publication makes use of data products from SPHEREx (JPL/Caltech, NASA).
